# Prerequisites — .secrets file (gitignored):
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
POSTGRES_CONNECTION_URI=postgresql://mle_migrations:mle_migrations@<rds_address>:port/main?sslmode=disable
KUBECONFIG_B64=<base64 of ./platform-gitops/kubeconfig/k3s.yaml>

# Generate KUBECONFIG_B64 (PowerShell):
$b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(".\platform-gitops\kubeconfig\k3s.yaml"))
Add-Content .secrets "KUBECONFIG_B64=$b64"

# ── Run CI workflows (build image, lint) ────────────────────────────────────
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-fraud-detection.yml     --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-drift-monitor.yml       --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-training-pipeline.yml   --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-archiving.yml           --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml               --secret-file .secrets

# ── Run CD workflows directly (manual rerollout after secret change) ─────────
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-fraud-detection.yml     --secret-file .secrets
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-drift-monitor.yml       --secret-file .secrets
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-training-pipeline.yml   --secret-file .secrets
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-archiving.yml           --secret-file .secrets
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-atlas.yml               --secret-file .secrets
